subject: End-of-quarter: OKR scoring, retro bullet draft, and QBR narrative request
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Cc: QBR Design Team <qbr-team@consulting.co>
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: End-of-quarter: OKR scoring, retro bullet draft, and QBR narrative request

Team —

Quick alignment for EoQ: I need calibrated OKR scores and a one-paragraph narrative per objective for the QBR packet by end of day Monday. We have a condensed deck to the board; their ask is two things: the numeric score and a short candid summary (what went well, what blocked us, and the single ask/action for next quarter).

Please use the attached okr-scores-template.xlsx and the QBR-narrative-template.docx. Guidance:
- Score on the 0.0–1.0 scale with two decimals (e.g., 0.75).
- Provide 2–4 succinct bullets for the retro and one 1–2 sentence narrative (no more than ~50 words).
- Flag any cross-team dependencies or things you want escalated to the execs.

I've pre-filled a couple of O/KRs where we had straightforward outcomes (see sheet: infra-costing baseline). Laura — can you own the Platform/Runtime OKRs? Hannah — can you lead Product metrics and Developer Experience? Marcus — big ask on Sales GTM KPIs (revenue/ACV cadence). Lauren — please add a short risk statement for Privacy & Compliance OKR.

If you're blocked by data, cc Jordan from Acme Analytics — they have the last-month token-cost export and can help with numbers (cc'd). If you expect your score to be >0.85 or <0.5, add one sentence justification.

Attachments: okr-scores-template.xlsx (sheet per Objective), QBR-narrative-template.docx (example language).

Thanks — let's keep the narratives candid; the board wants operational clarity, not marketing polish.

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Mar 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: End-of-quarter: OKR scoring, retro bullet draft, and QBR narrative request

Vivek — sending my scores and a short narrative inline. Attached updated OKR sheet (Platform tab completed).

Platform/Runtime (owner: Laura)
Score: 0.72
Retro bullets:
- Delivered latency p50 improvement of 18% for hosted API after kernel optimizations.
- Unexpected regression in large-batch throughput during blue-green cutover (investigation ongoing).
- Autoscaler instability with GPU drivers caused 4 hours of reduced capacity last week.
Narrative: We made solid latency gains through targeted kernel work, but rollout coordination exposed gaps in staging validation; immediate focus is on autoscaler regression tests and driver upgrade playbook.

Flag: Need a short postmortem on driver-caused capacity loss; recommend a brief dedicated follow-up with infra/ops.

Attachment: okr-scores-template.xlsx

Laura Bennett
Head of Platform
Redwood Inference
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Mar 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: End-of-quarter: OKR scoring, retro bullet draft, and QBR narrative request

Quick submission from Product/DevX:
Score: 0.88
Retro bullets:
- Developer onboarding time reduced from 3 days to 1.2 days after new quickstart and SDK examples.
- User research surfaced two high-friction areas in model rollout UX; small design effort scheduled for April.
- Eval automation covered 70% of critical prompt sets; gap on multi-turn safety tests remains.
Narrative: Significant improvement in developer productivity due to SDK and onboarding investments; remaining work is focused on rollout UX and completing multi-turn safety coverage.

Note: The 0.88 reflects shipped improvements; we did defer one safety automation sub-project which kept us from a >0.90.

Hannah
VP, Product
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2026 13:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: End-of-quarter: OKR scoring, retro bullet draft, and QBR narrative request

Sending Sales GTM KPIs and narrative. Attached updated sheet (Sales tab) and short slide for QBR.
Score: 0.64
Retro bullets:
- Closed two strategic Dedicated deals that improve forward visibility but slipped on expected ramp timing.
- Renewal motion improved with trial-to-paid conversion up 9% QoQ.
- Missed on enterprise pipeline expansion target due to slower procurement cycles at three accounts.
Narrative: Sales made progress in converting trials and landing strategic contracts, but procurement delays impacted expansion timing; next quarter focus is accelerating procurement playbooks and tighter cross-functional cadence.

Marcus Lin
Head of Growth & Revenue
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan <jordan@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2026 16:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: End-of-quarter: OKR scoring, retro bullet draft, and QBR narrative request

Appreciate the quick turn. Consolidated notes:
- Good level of candor — this is exactly what the board wants.
- Laura: please draft a 2-slide postmortem for the driver/autoscaler incident with clear mitigations (target: EOD Wed).
- Hannah: please prioritize the multi-turn safety test closure plan in April; add owner and ETA in the narrative template.
- Marcus: we'll surface procurement blockers as a cross-functional risk in the deck and call out required support from Legal/Finance.
- Lauren: I didn't see a Privacy & Compliance risk line yet — can you paste one sentence into the deck?

Jordan: could you confirm token-cost figures referenced in Platform tab by Wednesday morning?

I'll stitch these into the QBR packet and send a final draft for review by Thursday morning. If anyone needs extra time, call it out now.

—Vivek
VP, Engineering
Redwood Inference

--- Forwarded attachment list ---
Attached: okr-scores-template.xlsx, QBR-narrative-template.docx
